items.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Has Always Been Jensen Huang’s Company. What Happens to the Stock if That Changes?
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) stock would likely take a sharp initial hit if CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, but I believe the long-term investment case would remain intact. Huang has led Nvidia since co-founding it in 1993, making his leadership central to the chipmaker’s identity and success. Its board is now investigating reports that he was the target of a Chinese intelligence effort.
